Pick HubSpot if you run a content-heavy inbound marketing program or want its free CRM tools and large app marketplace. Pick CasperPortal if you run a local service business and want everything unlocked from day one.

faqs: Is CasperPortal a good HubSpot alternative for a small business?

Yes, if you run a local service business. CasperPortal puts CRM, two-way texting, missed-call text-back, booking, pipelines and review requests in one plan, so you don't need to assemble separate Hubs or add-ons.
How is CasperPortal priced compared to HubSpot?

CasperPortal's Growth Plan is $297/month with unlimited users and unlimited contacts, month-to-month. HubSpot sells separate Hubs with free and paid tiers, so check HubSpot's site for its current pricing.
Can I move my contacts from HubSpot to CasperPortal?
Yes. Export your contacts from HubSpot as a CSV and import them into CasperPortal. Automations need to be rebuilt, which you can do yourself or through optional done-for-you setup from CasperB2B.
Does CasperPortal have a free plan like HubSpot?
No. CasperPortal offers a 14-day free trial of the full Growth Plan, started at /start, and you can cancel anytime during the trial.

Yes. CasperPortal includes online booking and reminders, and every booking lands on a contact record with your texts, emails, pipeline stage and notes.
Can clients book online and get text reminders?
Yes. Clients book from your booking link, and workflows send email and text reminders before the appointment and follow-up afterward.
Do I need Zapier to connect booking to my CRM?
No. Booking, CRM, texting and automation are part of the same CasperPortal plan, so there's nothing to connect between them.
Is CasperPortal overkill if I only need scheduling?
It can be. If a booking link is all you need, a scheduling tool like Calendly may be enough. CasperPortal makes sense when you also want lead capture, follow-up and reviews.
